verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 family product page says the card is optimized for local AI inference across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other inference backends, so there is a thin first-party inference story. The evidence never covers low-precision formats or the specific stacks the story names. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support for this part, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support, LLM-specific performance or memory guidance, and independent hands-on LLM inference corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part

citations.quote: Access curated, GPU-optimized SDKs and models, and maximize performance across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends.
Stay ahead with the latest AI models the moment they drop - running faster, smoother, and fully private on your RTX-powered PC.
